name: European pond turtle
note: European pond turtles (docs 12, 13; pond tier since 2026-10-20). A few at a time, kept like a school (src/world/creatures/swarms.js): a group per pool, never single animals with names yet. LIFE. ecology: kind swarm; dormancy turtles (recipes/world/seasons.json): asleep in the pond mud from mid-autumn until the water has warmed, just after the start of summer, so they first come in summer and return each summer. needs (src/world/ecology/needs.js): water: still, warm fresh water depthM deep in a body of at least body.minM2; food: water lilies and pondweed (food plants, weight x size) over radiusM, against per x the ideal group; shelter: a basking spot. Its fields.basks counts the stones and logs you set (state.basks, from the pieces: loose stones, pond stones, kept logs, later the raft), a little cover from lilies and reeds too, the best within radiusM, from 'from', full at 'full'; with no stone or log near the water it never suits them. quiet: moderate. company: n[0] to n[2], n[1] ideal. scored: squares of a pool that suits them (where: water). arrival: as the minnows' and dragonflies' (see minnow.json), growing only in summer (growSeasons). gift: the floating reed raft (Matt 2026-10-21; unlocks.raft; the raft piece itself is built by the shaping session). LOOK: body: a blended-SDF turtle in real meters, body-local +z forward, origin at the middle of the plastron: a low domed carapace, a flatter plastron, a head on a short neck (head bone), four flippers, a short tail. displayScale 1.75 (Matt 2026-10-21 rescale: bigger than the frogs drawn). motion (src/world/creatures/bask.js; live only): by day (activity hours) each turtle climbs out onto a basking spot within baskReachM of its home (the stones, logs and raft from the pieces' seats, the highest first), and several stack on one when spots are few (stackM apart); it rests there with its head up, now and then turning it (lookEveryS); at night, in rain and in winter it sits low in the water. Paddling: paddleMps at the surface, the head just above it; haul-out takes climbS. A fast swoop close by (presence ringM) or an edit beside it: every basking turtle slides into the water and stays under for fleeS. find: as the minnows'.
